verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a REST API (e.g. 'Send a message' on its API docs page), so a downloadable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths, the Markdown docs path and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
